## Key facts

- Mueed Nazir Bhat is an AI automation and performance marketing specialist from Srinagar, India.
- He combines a 3+ year marketing and copywriting background with AI automation using LLMs, n8n, Zapier and Make.
- He designs end-to-end marketing automations from lead capture to follow-up, and builds funnels and paid campaigns tuned to CTR, ROAS and conversion.
- Recent AI-assisted client campaigns lifted brand visibility by 35% and engagement by 28%; automated content workflows cut production time and revision cycles by 25%.
- He has an M.Com from Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi, and a B.Com from the University of Delhi.
- He was Marketing Strategist & Copywriter at Sadat Paints & Plastics Pvt. Ltd. from Feb 2022 to Sep 2025, and has worked freelance since Jan 2022.
